endpoint_request types

Request

Request data class.

Available as lseg.data.delivery.endpoint_request.Request.

Syntax

Request(
    url: str,
    method: str = RequestMethod.GET,
    headers: dict = <factory>,
    data: dict | None = None,
    params: dict | None = None,
    json: dict | None = None,
    closure: str | None = None,
    auto_retry: bool = False,
    timeout: int | None = None,
    path: str | None = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
url str Yes URL used for the request.
method str No RequestMethod.GET HTTP method. GET by default.
headers dict No <factory> HTTP headers.
data dict | None No None Request body parameters.
params dict | None No None Request query parameters.
json dict | None No None JSON request body parameters.
closure str | None No None Closure that is passed to the headers and returned in the response.
auto_retry bool No False Flag to enable auto retry for the request. False by default.
timeout int | None No None Timeout for the request. If not set, the default session timeout is used.
path str | None No None Base path (e.g. /path/to/endpoint/{param}/) used for forming the request.
